tier: pilot; post-hoc mechanism check; never direct manuscript evidence
purpose: Test whether folds 3/7 event collapse is caused by the preregistered Shape-first checkpoint rule rather than absent event information.
dataset: MMECG loso_v2 folds 3/7, seed 42, full-support 8-second WSST
model: Frozen A1 dual-head REM-Net and frozen A2 structured decoder
control: q1_dual_head_full_loso_seed42 folds 3/7 selected lexicographically by Shape PCC, RMSE, then event F1.
candidate: Select maximum validation harmonic mean H=2*PCC_shape*F1_event/(PCC_shape+F1_event); ties use Shape PCC then negative RMSE.
frozen: AdamW lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4, maximum 100 epochs, patience 15
Q/R/S/T targets, probability threshold 0.5 and A2 physiological windows
Validation-only selection and one-time test opening

promotion_gate.event_recovery: Structured macro F1@100 and mean Q/R/S/T coverage each improve by at least 0.30 on each fold.
promotion_gate.shape_safety: Test Shape PCC decreases by no more than 0.05 on either fold.
promotion_gate.ordering: Structured Q<R<S<T violation rate remains zero wherever a complete beat exists.
promotion_gate.decision: All clauses pass: authorise a separately registered prospective full rerun with the balanced checkpoint rule. Otherwise stop this route.

bias_disclosure: Folds 3/7 were selected after observing their prior failure. This diagnoses mechanism and cannot repair or replace the original 11-fold evidence.
